verdict.rationale: Bento has no documented bulk-action feature such as multi-select triage or batch updates, but its CLI lets you do everything the dashboard does from a script or CI, with raw JSON output you can pipe into jq. So bulk operations can be built by looping over list commands. Signals also backfill across your entire trace history, and recurring failures are auto-grouped into issues and clusters, which are aggregate operations of a kind. Missing for 10: a native bulk update or triage command for many issues or signals at once, a documented batch API (no OpenAPI spec was found), and hands-on corroboration.
